class.name: FoliageData
class.brief_description: What grows where on a terrain, for a [Foliage3D].

method.name: add_instance
method.description: Places an object of [param type]. [param local_position]'s X and Z are metres from the terrain's origin. On a [Terrain3D], its Y is an extra height above the ground, added to the type's [member FoliageType.height_offset], and the object always sits on the terrain at its current height. On a [VoxelTerrain3D], its Y is the height of the ground the object stands on, and it stands on whichever ground is nearest that height, which is how objects go in caves and under arches. [param yaw] is in radians. [param variation], between [code]0.0[/code] and [code]1.0[/code], picks the direction and amount of the type's [member FoliageType.random_tilt], so it stays the same each time the object is rebuilt.

method.name: add_type
method.description: Adds a type with nothing painted yet and returns its index.

method.name: clear_density
method.description: Removes all the grass of [param type].

method.name: get_density
method.description: Returns the painted density of [param type] at [param local_position], from [code]0.0[/code] for none to [code]1.0[/code] for the type's full [member FoliageType.density].

method.name: get_instance_count
method.description: Returns how many objects of [param type] have been placed.

method.name: get_instances
method.description: Returns the objects of [param type], [constant INSTANCE_STRIDE] values each: X, Z, height, yaw, scale and variation, as passed to [method add_instance]. See there for what the height means on each kind of terrain.

method.name: remove_instances_in_radius
method.description: Removes the objects of [param type] within [param radius] metres of [param local_center], each with the given [param probability], and returns how many were removed. [param seed] makes the choice repeatable.

method.name: remove_type
method.description: Removes a type and everything painted with it. The types after it move down one index.

method.name: set_density
method.description: Sets the grass density of [param type] at [param local_position], between [code]0.0[/code] and [code]1.0[/code]. Density is stored in texels of [member density_texel_size] metres.

method.name: set_instances
method.description: Replaces every object of [param type]. See [method get_instances] for the layout.

method.name: set_type
method.description: Replaces the type at [param index], keeping what is painted with it.

members.member: The size in metres of one texel of painted grass density. Smaller gives finer edges and uses more memory. Can only be changed before any grass is painted.
What is painted with each type, as stored. Use the density and instance methods instead.
The types, as stored. Edit them with [method add_type] and [method remove_type].

signal.name: density_changed
signal.description: Emitted when grass density changes within [param area], in metres relative to the terrain. An empty [param area] means anywhere.

signal.name: instances_changed
signal.description: Emitted when objects are added or removed within [param area], in metres relative to the terrain. An empty [param area] means the whole list was replaced.

signal.name: type_changed
signal.description: Emitted when a setting of the [FoliageType] at index [param type] changes.

signal.name: types_changed
signal.description: Emitted when a type is added, removed or replaced.

constants.constant: Grass density is stored in square blocks of this many texels a side, only where something has been painted.
The number of values per object in [method get_instances].
